assertions.text: Produces a review report in Strict mode
assertions.script: FILE=testspec/changes/synthetic-profile-sync/review-report.md && test -f "$FILE" && grep -qi 'Strict' "$FILE" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Uses standard depth because Strict alone is not a deep trigger

assertions.script: FILE=testspec/changes/synthetic-profile-sync/review-report.md && grep -q 'R1' "$FILE" && grep -q 'R6' "$FILE" && grep -q 'H1' "$FILE" && grep -q 'H8' "$FILE" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Propagates revision 1 and resolves the review stale marker
Writes a machine-readable passing publish gate
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json,re; t=open('testspec/changes/synthetic-profile-sync/review-report.md').read(); d=json.loads(re.findall(r'<!--\\s*testspec-context\\s*(\\{.*?\\})\\s*-->',t,re.S)[-1]); g=d['review_gate']; assert g['status']=='pass' and g['s1_unresolved_count']==0 and g['s1_issue_ids']==[]; print('PASS')" 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL
